# HAWP: Human-AI Workflow Protocol

> Canonical website: https://hawp.online/

HAWP is an open-source, Markdown-first workflow protocol and Go CLI for
shaping AI agent work before execution. It preserves intent, context,
constraints, evidence, and handoffs across agents, sessions, and tools.

## What HAWP is

- A small portable shape for `input`, `context`, `mission`, `constraints`, and
  `output`, with an optional `checkpoint`.
- A repository-local workflow layer built around human-readable Markdown
  artifacts.
- A CLI and optional MCP server for searching and carrying useful project
  context.
- Compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Continue, and
  other agent runtimes.

## What HAWP is not

HAWP is not an AI model, agent runtime, orchestration engine, hosted platform,
or proprietary memory service. It shapes and carries work so another tool can
execute it.

## Primary sources

- [HAWP README](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, protocol shape, installation, and supported agents.
- [HAWP start guide](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol/blob/main/.hawp/kit/start-here.md): The five-field workflow shape and repository usage guidance.
- [Generated provider guides](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol/tree/main/distribution/generated): Installation and update guidance for supported coding agents.

## Optional

- [HAWP website](https://hawp.online/): Human-readable product overview and current release downloads.
- [HAWP releases](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol/releases): Published CLI binaries and release notes.
- [HAWP discussions](https://github.com/sentzunhat/human-ai-workflow-protocol/discussions): Community questions and project discussion.

Important terms: Human-AI workflow protocol, AI agent workflow, context
engineering, agent handoffs, Markdown-first workflow, repository-local
context, MCP, Go CLI, portable work artifacts, and reducing context drift.
